title: Non-MCMC Constraints on the EFC α-Parameter: BAO, Growth-Rate, and Cluster Evidence
description: Validation note EFC-VAL-2026-005. We present non-MCMC constraints on the EFC alpha parameter from five independent datasets: DESI Y1 BAO, BOSS DR12 BAO, multi-epoch growth rate (fσ8), IllustrisTNG cluster statistics, and cosmic chronometer H(z). Non-MCMC results are treated strictly as model-comparison metrics, not as parameter posteriors. While concurrent MCMC inference is degeneracy-limited (alpha = -0.101 +/- 0.212, 0.479 sigma), cross-validation and likelihood-ratio methods show consistent directional preference for EFC: Delta-chi^2 = -22.01 (DESI Y1, 5-fold CV), Delta-chi^2 = -7.77 (BOSS DR12, k_eff = 0), and alpha = -1.00 +/- 0.46 (2.20 sigma) from multi-epoch fσ8 with LOO 7/7 and Delta-AIC = -2.91. Non-MCMC results are within ~0.7 sigma of previously sealed blind predictions (alpha = -0.702, -0.689). The MCMC posterior shows a ~2.8 sigma tension with the same priors. We interpret this as methodological tension between inference frameworks under degeneracy, not as a detection-level signal. This note formalises results previously held only in an internal breakthrough tracker, registers two new validation IDs (DESI Y1, IllustrisTNG), and cross-references prior validations EFC-VAL-2026-002 and EFC-VAL-2026-003.
